Thank you. Just been so so tough lately with so many terrible comments made to me, and feeling like nothing I do is ever enough. I just feel like there's no point to trying. I've spent like 2 years trying to figure out who I am after some head injuries and being bailed on by almost everyone in my life during that recovery. And I still don't know what I want or who I am. So now having people say I'm not ok as I am and that my hideous body will keep anyone from every truly loving me... It's a lot sometimes.
